decision.observation: At 10:30 p.m. Saturday, the farmer is standing on the southern east–west cobblestone road at the bottom of the fountain path; the road extends east toward a fenced area.
decision.hypothesis: Moving east while staying on this road should reach the river crossing and the route south to the beach, rather than entering the wooded area south of town.
decision.memory: Willy invited the farmer to the southeast beach. Avoid the wooded southern exit; follow the town road east across the river before turning south. Repeated late nights have reduced money.
